summary: Design EPR collection, financing, and monitoring systems for packaging and e-waste. Explore practical case work and enrol in the course.
lede: Extended producer responsibility training helps teams plan and monitor packaging and electronic-waste systems. For environmental regulators, waste managers, producer-responsibility organisations and sustainability staff, it covers mapping roles, comparing collection models, estimating costs, applying material flow analysis, creating producer-register templates, and defining collection and recovery indicators and compliance follow-up through practical exercises.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate, monitor, or advise packaging and electronic-waste producer responsibility systems.
modules: OECD EPR Guidance and System Design
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: familiarity with waste collection, environmental compliance, producer obligations, or sustainability reporting. No programming is required. Basic spreadsheet skills will help with the monitoring exercises; participants using hands-on digital activities should have access to a laptop with Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet. QGIS is used for collection-point mapping concepts and is available as open-source software.
